comment: Persons Unknown ward development fight stills. A live human collects the Shotgun, clears two seated Clerks, hears the lower-stair Crawler before a clear view, survives its crouch and leap, then clears a three-Crawler pack with a Sweeper before the ward, floor and dock. The ward guards must fall before the physical restraint control can release Latch. Latch opens a second occupied bay, then sees Low Water on the transfer list. Accurate aim is capture evidence, not a difficulty review. This is not the finished M02 mission.

states.name: gallery_arrival
states.note: Arrival on the observation gallery. The ward view and Latch presentation are still graybox work.

states.name: shotgun_discovery
states.note: The guaranteed Shotgun is visible ahead on the upper gallery before it is claimed.

states.name: upper_gallery_loadout
states.note: The player collects the Shotgun and Shells before entering the guard room.

states.name: seated_guard_room
states.note: Two Clerks wait with weapons down at the guard-room table before their encounter activates.

states.name: guard_room_fight
states.note: Both guard-room Clerks defeated after the Shotgun pickup and before the stairs.

states.name: crawler_scrabble
states.note: The first Crawler's positional scrabble and live caption arrive from below the switchback before the player has a clear view of the lower landing.

states.name: crawler_solo
states.note: The player moves down the switchback during the first Crawler attack, evades its locked leap, then defeats it on the grounded landing without losing HP.

states.name: crawler_pack_spectator
states.note: A detached observer camera frames the active Crawler and Sweeper pack on the raised landing before the player begins this fight.

states.name: crawler_pack
states.note: Three low Crawlers cross the next landing while a taller Sweeper fires behind its screen; the four named enemies fall before the ward.

states.name: ward_fight
states.note: The ward guards fall and correction halts before the restraint is opened.

states.name: latch_restrained
states.note: Latch remains at the closed restraint until the player reaches the local frame control.

states.name: latch_release
states.note: A real F press at the ward frame releases Latch once; the second occupied bay is still shut.

states.name: second_bay_open
states.note: Latch crosses to another captive and the second bay visibly opens before their first speech.

states.name: low_water_list
states.note: The ward transfer list names Low Water, and the opened second bay remains a world fact.

states.name: floor_fight
states.note: The processing floor after its fight.

states.name: dock_fight
states.note: The loading dock after its fight.

states.name: departed
states.note: Detached view back across the dock after GET OUT completes; the server record marks the mission complete.
